<!-- Search existing issues first. Use synthetic examples, without secrets or
private target data. A request does not commit the project to a release date.
See SUPPORT.md and docs/RELEASE_PLAN.md for scope and version policy. -->

## Problem or question

What are you trying to achieve, and who is affected? For a usage question,
include the Faultora version, documented steps tried and where you got stuck.

## Desired outcome

Describe an observable result and how you would check it. Distinguish what is
needed from a possible implementation.

## Existing options

Which current features or workarounds did you try? Link the relevant docs or
issues, and explain any remaining limitation.
